page.notes: The marginal note reads "y Lib.5. ca.14.", with the reference mark y. Mark y in the text stands after "tefte". The text is cut off at the foot of this part and continues on the second image. The s of "Sozomeno" line 1 is a plain s, and some words are read from the image with a spot of ink near "magiltratus" that is not a letter. Reference marks in the text are a small z before "se quoque" and a small a before "Gregorio"; the margin notes carry the same letters. The opening bracket "[" before "nobis" is printed and kept. The line "gladiorū acię" ends with a printed tilde over the e; read as ę with [?]. "re-" below the last line is the catchword. Show-through marks in the right margin are not transcribed. Printing errors left as printed: "Iouianum" is read as Iovianum by the u/v rule.
